info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Education Enrollments Certificates-v4-spec
info.description: This API provides access to a list of certificates associated with education enrollments. It permits users to retrieve detailed information about certificates for enrolled students, including their status and relevant metadata. Typically utilized by educational institutions and administrative staff, it supports use cases such as tracking enrollment progress and validating student achievements. The API streamlines access to essential enrollment data, aiding in effective record management and reporting.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve the certificate associated with a specific enrollment. It provides the details of the certificate that can be used for verification or record-keeping purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve enrollment certificate data based on provided criteria. It must be formatted as a JSON object and should adhere to the defined schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the certificate details.

ListEducationEnrollmentsCertificatesRequ.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to enrollments and certificates.
